text: Asha's daughter starts reception on Sept 4th. Asha said she's more nervous than the kid is. Text her that morning to see how drop-off went
lachlan flying to auckland june 3rd, 26 hrs door to door w a stopover in singapore. back the 21st
Kevin and Lucy graduated together on May 14 - both nursing degrees. Party at Lucy's parents' place the weekend after
Need to get Adaeze a card before her son's graduation, it's 6/12. She mentioned he's been eyeing a proper fountain pen

so Ximena called and um her mum's having the hip operation on the 9th and Ximena is flying out to Bogotá the day before to be with her, staying about three weeks, she sounded pretty worn out honestly, and her partner Lior is staying here with the kids so I said I'd I'd pop round to see him and the kids a week after she goes, maybe bring dinner
Blessing - twins sit their 11+ Saturday. Wish them luck Friday night
Lior has a golden retriever called Biscuit who apparently eats socks
Anan's Japan trip is off, his dad's not well enough to travel. They're doing a week in Cornwall instead, Aug 18
Ali passed his driving test!! Second go. Said he nearly stalled at the roundabout

Kasia's brother Milan moves to Toronto October 2nd for a job at a bank there. She's helping him pack the week before and then flying out with him to help find a flat, back on the 12th. Their mum isn't taking it well, keeps saying he'll never come home. Kasia asked if I could water her plants while she's away
Remember to message Laila the day after her viva, 11/7
Delroy retiring end of March after 32 yrs at the council. Leaving do the Friday after, I'm doing the speech
Anya mentioned her and Sara are off to Lisbon for their anniversary, July 22nd to the 27th. First proper holiday since the baby
ming = vegetarian, no mushrooms either
Book car MOT before the 30th. Also renew passport, expires Feb

Long chat with Eli at pickup. His youngest started Year 1 this week and is struggling with the longer days, crying at the gate most mornings. Eli's wife Rin has gone back to work full time at the hospital so he's doing all the school runs now and looks knackered. He said things should settle after half term. Check in with him a week after half term, and maybe offer to take the kids one afternoon

Wiremu off to Rarotonga for his cousin's wedding, Dec 12. Flies via LA, something like 30 hours all in. His wife Hana and the kids go out a week earlier with her parents. He's got a presentation at work on the 10th he can't move, so he's joining them two days later and flying back alone the day after Boxing Day

Dana's GCSE results come out Aug 21. She thinks she flunked chemistry. Ring her that afternoon. Her dad Milan said they're going to Mallorca the day after either way, sort of a reward or a consolation, and that her older brother is picking up his own uni results the same week. Lot going on in that house
Jonah and Hana got engaged in Kyoto!! Proposed on the last night of the trip
Connor's mum passed last week. Funeral is Thursday 10am at St Mary's. I'm driving Bridget
Bridget mentioned Kai - her nephew - is getting his black belt grading on the 15th. She's going to watch
Anjali Sato, new neighbour at no. 14, works as a pharmacist at the hospital. Two kids, husband is Ignacio
emre starting at bristol uni sept 20, doing engineering. his mum is a wreck about it lol
Kieran's sister Sara has her wedding in Crete on 9/14. He's best man and terrified of the speech. Send him a good luck text the morning of
Note to self: Lucy's birthday is April 2. She's into pottery, hinted at a wheel-throwing class voucher
Asha said her dad's coming over from Nairobi for the graduation, arriving the Tuesday before. Ceremony is June 18th

Did Kevin hear back about the Melbourne job? Interview was last Thursday, video call at 11pm because of the time difference. If he gets it he'd move out in Feb and his girlfriend Anjali would follow after she finishes her teacher training in the summer. He seemed weirdly calm. Must ask him this week
Wiremu (Wiz) just got back from three weeks in Vietnam, says Hoi An was the highlight. Jet lag killing him
Lachlan's little one starts nursery on Monday. Lachlan's partner is doing the first drop off and he's doing pickup
dentist 3:15 tuesday. pick up dry cleaning on the way back
Blessing's husband Delroy got the promotion, regional manager. Starts in the new role Jan 6. They're celebrating at the Thai place Saturday
Hana's mum is having a scan on the 3rd and then results the week after. Hana's taking her. Text Hana after the results
Adaeze is doing a half marathon in Edinburgh May 25th, first one ever. Training going badly, shin splints. Flying up the day before with her sister

Okay so Ali and Kasia are both going to the reunion on March 8th, and Ali said he'd drive Kasia there but she's coming back the next morning on the train because she has a shift. Remind me to ask Ali for the address
Ming's twins graduated primary school today. Ming cried through the whole thing apparently
Anan loves vintage film cameras, has like forty of them. Collects Olympus specifically
Milan's flight to Seoul got cancelled so he's going on the 5th instead of the 3rd. Arrives the morning after
Lior's dog Biscuit is having surgery on Friday, knee ligament. Lior's really anxious about it. Check how Biscuit is the day after
Uncle Delroy turns 70 on Nov 3rd. Big family lunch planned for the Sunday after, at the golf club. Need to chip in for the group present
Sara and her husband are flying to Sydney for Christmas to see his family, 23 hours plus a layover in Dubai. She's dreading it with a toddler
Eli mentioned Connor got into the county under 14 cricket squad. Trials were last month
Dana's son starts secondary next month, same school as Kai. They're walking in together on the first day
I'm taking Laila to the airport for her 6am flight on the 19th. Pick her up at 3:30
Kieran nervous about his citizenship test, it's on 2/28
Rin Fischer — Eli's wife — new job at the Royal Infirmary as a ward sister. Started in September, loves it so far
don't forget to wish Ximena happy birthday Wednesday!!

Jonah's sister Anya is due in April. First grandchild on both sides, so the parents are beside themselves. Baby shower is March 15 at her in-laws'. Jonah says she's been really sick and is off work till the 20 week scan, then they find out if it's a boy or girl the day after. She'd like a nice baby carrier apparently
Bridget's daughter got her A level results this morning, A*AA, she's off to Durham to do law. Bridget sounded so proud. Should send a card

Spent ages with Asha and Kevin at the barbecue. Asha's off to Peru for the Inca Trail on July 9, ten days, she's been training on weekends. Kevin's moving into his new flat on the 1st and has asked if I can help carry stuff that morning. Said yes. Asha also mentioned her brother Emre is retaking his maths exam on June 5th and is really stressed
Kai has a peanut allergy, carries an epipen
Lucy's flight from Toronto lands 7:40am Saturday. She'll want a nap afterwards, so lunch is Sunday
Ignacio's PhD graduation is May 30. His parents flying in from Santiago a few days before. He's having drinks that evening
Laila broke up with her boyfriend. The move to Leeds together is off. She's ok-ish
Call Wiremu about the Christchurch trip before he books flights
Anjali hates flying, takes the ferry everywhere when she can
Connor Brennan says the school play is Dec 10 and 11, his son Jonah is playing a shepherd. Get tickets for the 11th
Mrs Kowalski at the bakery said her granddaughter just graduated as a vet. Very proud
Hana and Jonah's wedding is Aug 16, then honeymoon in Bali the week after. Need to RSVP by May 1st
Kids' passports both expire in May, renew before the summer trip. Forms at the post office
Nothing much from the parents' evening really. Just the usual, more reading at home
